topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I just found out someone's been using my art, but not just using it—tattooing it onto their skin. Like they had the right to take something I poured hours into, something personal and significant, and make it a permanent part of them without asking. The nerve. I mean, I get flattery, sure, but there’s a line. This crosses it. Now I’m supposed to feel honored? No way. I’m going to find out who did this, and they’re going to hear from me. People need to respect an artist’s work and boundaries. Enough is enough.
